_comment: Tier-2 for febio::polar_fluid#3. Two invented names, caught at DIFFERENT stages: <bc type="zero micro-rotation"> is a parse error ('tag "bc" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"'), while <var type="micro rotation"/> reads SUCCESS and only then aborts with 'FATAL ERROR: Output variable "micro rotation" is not defined'. The fixture asserts read_success on the second, which is the stage difference the claim is about. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
